subject: Skywave: sudden p95/p99 RTT inflation — suspected cross-region routing change
messages:
From: Skywave Analytics <infra@skywaveanalytics.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:08:00 +0000
Subject: [URGENT] Sudden p95/p99 RTT jumps this morning

Hi Vanessa,

Over the last 45 minutes our dashboard is showing a sharp increase in p95 and p99 latency for calls going to the Redwood hosted API from our EU region. p95 jumped from ~85ms to ~350ms and error rates spiked briefly. This started right after 10:00 UTC.

We rely on consistent tail latency for our user-facing inference. Can you confirm if anything changed on your side (routing, peering, edge config)? We can share traces/IDs on request — example trace id: 8a3f-rt-020.

Our integration contact: Carol Lin (carol.lin@skywaveanalytics.com). This is impacting production. Please advise timeline and mitigation steps.

Thanks,
Carol
Infra Lead, Skywave Analytics

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:34:00 +0000
Subject: Re: [URGENT] Sudden p95/p99 RTT jumps this morning

Hi all —

Quick summary from infra: we pushed a region-affinity routing change to the WAN egress policy at ~09:54 UTC to bias traffic for new customers toward us-east for load balancing. That policy accidentally included a route tag used by existing EU tenants (bad selector). As a result, a subset of EU traffic was hairpinned across transatlantic links to us-east before hitting regional inference pods. Measured effect: median RTT unchanged, but p95 increased ~260ms and p99 ~480ms for affected routes. Error rate went up for short spikes while connections timed out.

Actions taken so far:
- Identified the offending commit and rolled the policy to a canary (we removed the tag selector) at 15:12 UTC.
- Reverted the global change entirely at 15:28 UTC.
- Running targeted validation across eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. Early telemetry shows p95 trending back toward baseline but not fully recovered for some customer flows (cache/KV re-warm needed).

Next steps / ETA:
- Continue validation for 60 minutes.
- Share perf dump and traceroutes (attached).
- If Skywave still sees elevated tails after 60 minutes we will open a dedicated maintenance window to force regional rebinds and clear KV caches (20–30 min).

Root cause: incorrect route selector in a deployment meant to affect only new-tenant prefixes. We'll follow up with a PR-level blocker to ensure selectors are unit-tested.

Jonas Weber
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Attachments: perf_dump_20270630.tar.gz, edge-routing-change.diff
From: Carol Lin <carol.lin@skywaveanalytics.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: infra@skywaveanalytics.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: [URGENT] Sudden p95/p99 RTT jumps this morning

Thanks Jonas — that explanation aligns with what we see. Our traces (sample): 8a3f-rt-020, 8a3f-rt-021 between 10:02–10:10 UTC show a ~300ms added hop. We'll monitor the next hour.

A couple asks from Skywave:
- Confirm whether this will trigger any retention/consistency impact for in-flight KV cache items (we see a few inference failures tied to cache misses).
- Given this impacted user-facing latency, can we discuss a good-faith credit for the incident and a timeline for a written postmortem?

We appreciate the quick rollback. Please keep us posted.

— Carol

Attachments: none
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
To: carol.lin@skywaveanalytics.com, infra@skywaveanalytics.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: [URGENT] Sudden p95/p99 RTT jumps this morning — rollback complete + next steps

Carol —

Following up: rollback completed and we finished validation across the EU regions. Telemetry shows p95 back to ~95ms for the vast majority of Skywave traffic; a tiny fraction of sessions still showing elevated tails due to KV warm-up (these should normalize within 30–45 minutes).

What we delivered:
- Immediate rollback executed (15:28 UTC) and regional rebinds run for affected prefixes (completed 16:20 UTC).
- Postmortem draft link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-skywave-postmortem — will publish a finalized PM with timeline and remediation items by EOD tomorrow.
- Good-faith gesture: account credit equivalent to 25% of last month’s hosted API bill while we finalize impact. Marissa from sales is looping to handle the credit and formal paperwork.

Longer-term fixes:
- PR-level gating for route selector changes + unit tests.
- Add a canary phase that evaluates silhouette metrics (p95/p99) before promotion.
- Improve our tracing hooks to detect cross-region hairpin in real time and auto-roll back within 5 minutes.

I'll stay on point for the customer comms and the PM. Jonas will post the engineering remediation items to INF-9876.

Thanks for your patience — we take this seriously.

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
